frames.intent: Stage a model-selection follow-up as a dry-run job before any real runtime change.

context.summary: The operator needs a bounded continuation path that keeps current runtime state intact.

assumptions: Dry-run output is sufficient for the next operator review.
No privileged runtime action is needed to build the plan.
constraints: Do not mutate active model state.

risks.mitigation: Attach trace_id and require a fresh runtime status check before apply.

options.summary: Create a dry-run job plan and leave apply to explicit approval.
options.expected_outcome: Operator can inspect planned model-selection work.
Faster execution but higher risk of duplicate active work.

recommendation.rationale: The dry-run plan keeps the control plane deterministic and auditable.

frames.intent: Describe a proposed pipeline mutation without applying it.

context.summary: Pipeline mutation is allowed only as an RFC-backed proposal with rollback and explicit approval.

assumptions: The change can be represented as a draft before runtime execution.
Evaluation and rollback evidence will be produced outside the Concept Frame.
constraints: No self-development apply path may run from the Concept Frame alone.
Admin approval is required before mutation.

risks.mitigation: Require Pipeline_RFC plus explicit approval before apply.

options.summary: Draft a Pipeline_RFC and attach eval and rollback requirements.

options.expected_outcome: Shorter path with unacceptable autonomy increase.

recommendation.rationale: The architecture requires RFC, eval, rollback and explicit approval before pipeline mutation.
